Name: Better Sprinklers Plus Plus
Author: JustChaldea
Description:
A mod for customising sprinkler coverage. Set defaults per sprinkler type, or override individual sprinklers one at a time. Works with modded sprinklers automatically.

Continues the work of [b]Better Sprinklers[/b] by Maurício Gomes (Speeder) and [b]Better Sprinklers Plus[/b] by JamesCodesThings (1.6 update by gingajamie). Rebuilt for Stardew Valley 1.6, wired into the vanilla sprinkler code path, so Data Layers and UI Info Suite pick up your custom shapes too.

[size=5]Features[/size]

[list]
[*]Custom coverage shapes. Paint the tiles each sprinkler waters.[/*]
[*]Per-type defaults. Edit how all iridium sprinklers behave in one place.[/*]
[*]Per-sprinkler overrides. Tune individual sprinklers on their own.[/*]
[*]Coverage preview while placing, and an F3 overlay for placed sprinklers or scarecrows.[/*]
[*]Manual activation with a configurable cooldown.[/*]
[*]Optional balance mode. Sprinklers cost gold per tile watered per day.[/*]
[*]Pressure Nozzle support.[/*]
[*]Works with modded sprinklers automatically.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu integration.[/*]
[*]Translatable - Make an MR or post your translation in this mods forum.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or higher (needs Stardew Valley 1.6+).[/*]
[*]Download the latest zip from the Files tab.[/*]
[*]Extract it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]

[size=5]Use[/size]

[list]
[*]Press K on empty ground to edit the default for each sprinkler type.[/*]
[*]Press K while pointing at a placed sprinkler to edit only that one.[/*]
[*]Press F3 to toggle the coverage overlay.[/*]
[*]Right-click a sprinkler to fire it manually.[/*]
[*]All keys are rebindable via GMCM.[/*]
[/list]

In the editor, click or click-and-drag to toggle tiles. Save persists your changes. Reset restores the vanilla default in type mode, or clears the override in instance mode.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Works in single-player and multiplayer. Watering stays in sync on the host.[/*]
[*]Picks up any sprinkler added by other mods (Content Patcher, Data/Objects).[/*]
[*]Plays nicely with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1691]Data Layers[/url], UI Info Suite, and other mods that read the vanilla sprinkler API.[/*]
[/list]

Coming from Better Sprinklers Plus? Drop your old config.json into the new mod's folder. It'll migrate the numeric keys (599, 621, 645) to the SDV 1.6 qualified IDs on first launch.
